notes.title: Post release patch #1
notes.notes:
Includes a few bugfixes and quality of life updates:
[list]
[*] Windowed vs full screen and screen resolution can now be selected in the options menu.
[*] A soft lock where controller players can get stuck if they are currently selecting a spawn point they lost in the spawn screen has been removed.
[*] Some of the pikemen's resting spear angles were off and didn't update correctly. This should be fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Mode Overview and Demo Release Details
notes.notes:
Hello all! As release approaches I'm about to release the promotional Demo for the game and more of these updates will take place as we get closer to launch.

[h2]Demo release date
[/h2]Our public beta demo of the game is releasing for the Real Time Strategy Fest on January 20th and will include the following features ahead of our launch in late March.
[list]
[*] Tutorial missions explaining basic mechanics and main game modes
[*] Human and Undead playable factions (Elves, Orcs, and Dwarves included in full game)
[*] 2 Conquest Maps against either bots or other players in couch coop
[*] 1 wave survival Siege Mode Map.
[/list]

The Demo page can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3417800/Broad_Sword_Demo]here[/url]

This week were taking a look at an overview of the 3 game modes featured in Broad Sword.

[h2]Conquest Mode
[/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667620/29441e9b3bab0b662b6e7095df2f44a8448321eb.png[/img]
The main goal of Conquest is to secure the majority of objective points on the map to gradually reduce their remaining supply points, but you'll need to make sure to capture enough spawn points to dominate the battlefield and maintain control. You can play against bots and/or your friends in local multiplayer.

[h2]Siege Mode
[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667620/ddf525a9ca1445e0076ff33406b9d67dbd08c371.gif[/img]
In Siege maps you must defend your castle by securing its spawn points and selecting and positioning your troops carefully before the enemy attacks from waves of siege towers trying to take over the fortification. Victory against armies will unlock harder versions of those armies so test your skill and see how long you can last!

[h2]Campaign Mode
[/h2]
The Campaign takes all 10 conquest maps and bundles them into an overworld hex grid that the 5 factions fight for control over. Any map tiles you control provide manpower and additional troop types to your battles while you control them to spread over the map and conquer the world as your own! More will be shown as the game approaches full release.

notes.title: Major revamp Omelet Update
notes.notes:
In order to make an omelet you need to crack a few eggs. Over the last few months we've made a lot of upgrades to core systems and under the hood features, but since these updates touched a lot of core systems much of the content in the game was broken and needed to be rebuilt. As of today the game is stable enough to share the build, but some features still need tweaking and polish. Here's a summary of the major updates made:

[list]
[*] Core system refactor - Much of the code has been cleaned up and refined to remove bugs, improve performance and to make it easier to modify going forward.
[*] Visual update - This improved performance allowed for graphical improvements while maintaining performance benchmarks. Unit shading is improved, the maps have been revamped to use Unity's terrain system, and dead units ragdoll.
[*] Gameplay updates - Unit AI has been differentiated to allow different unit types to have their own logic as needed, projectile attacks now have an arcing trajectory, and melee units will engage enemies attacking them without needing player input. Capture mechanics have been improved including easier to capture spawns as contesting points delay troops spawning in.
[*] UI - The UI has been revamped and the respawn screen has been reworked to allow more variety of loadouts.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667620/8ea8a664dc3dd2279d2b08aecba19652ad512a3a.jpg[/img]

Known issues: 
[list]
[*] many of the sound FX are missing 
[*] Unit types and factions temporarily have the same stats. The stat variations will be added back as the light and heavy armor units are added in.
[*] Some UI navigation issues when in split screen multiplayer
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44667620/908e22bcec2b62bb22f827d47caf5f3ce723cc6b.jpg[/img]
The path forward:
[list]
[*] The immediate future will focus adding missing content including filling out the unit loadouts, adding unique stats, and making another pass at the sound FX, which will then be followed by giving factions their unique unit types including things like Giants, Mages, Crossbowmen, etc.
[*] The next major update would be to include a wave survival "Siege" mode where you can either by yourself or cooperatively with a friend hold out against increasingly deadly waves of units.
[*] The last mode to be added before the 1.0 release would involve a conquest campaign with a turn based overworld leading to individual battles.
[/list]

Be sure to try out the new update and let me know your thoughts on our brand spanking new discord [url=https://discord.gg/w6ASNqjX]here[/url].
